# Glossline Auto Care — Copilot Instructions

- Before substantial work, read `AGENTS.md`, `PROJECT_BRIEF.md`, `DESIGN_BLUEPRINT.md`, and `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`.
- Treat those repository documents as authoritative over chat history; follow their project safety, content, form, accessibility, and scope restrictions.
- Work only on the milestone explicitly approved by the user. Inspect the workspace and affected files before changes, and do not overwrite unrelated work.
- Do not add features, dependencies, or external services outside approved scope.
- Stop and ask if approval, requirements, or the current milestone are ambiguous or conflicting.
- Report exact file changes and only checks actually performed. Stop after the authorized milestone and wait for approval.
- Use only relevant core skills from the permanent policy in `AGENTS.md`; verify native discovery and load actual instructions before use. Do not copy, reinstall, or duplicate skills, and report if a required skill is unavailable.
- Skills do not override approved scope, form restrictions, design tokens, or milestone gates. Native skill discovery is verified for Copilot and Cline; OpenCode remains unaudited and must be checked before compatibility is claimed.
